tool.description: Generate a fresh RSA key pair of the chosen size (2048, 3072, or 4096 bits) and return the private key (PKCS#8 PEM) and public key (SPKI PEM). Keys are generated locally with a cryptographic RNG. Default key size is 2048.

key_size.description: RSA key size in bits. Larger is more secure but slower to generate. Default 2048.
